name: isage
summary: ISP (iSage Internet Pty Ltd, ©1998-2012; dialup, ADSL, VoIP, hosting); after Veridas collapsed 2006, re-contracted with ispOne; site up to 2012 (ACN 133 451 224).

events.details: Site last captured 2012. Retail ISP homepage ran to 27 Jul 2021 and was cut to members/webmail-only by 24 Sep 2021 — later than the current 'by 2012' and the proposed c. 2020.

refs.label: Full retail ISP marketing site as late as 27 Jul 2021.
By 24 Sep 2021 the homepage was reduced to a members/webmail strip (unchanged through 2025 captures) — webmail-only = dead.
Live site today is the same login strip — public ISP presence gone since Sep 2021.
ABR: ISAGE INTERNET PTY. LTD. ACN 133 451 224
